insights.concise_text: The paper defines linguistic generalization as understanding structurally valid utterances regardless of probability, then tests it with uncharacteristic inputs that are not typical in the training distribution but remain solvable.

insights.concise_text: Although all models achieve near perfect accuracy on the standard test set, the variability in generalization on uncharacteristic inputs across random seeds is described as alarming.
